sources.entry: Clipbara - Free Paste-like clipboard manager with pinboards, Quick Look previews, and one-click copying. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/mobrava/Clipbara) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/clipbara/id6803537696?platform=mac)
Clipbara - Paste-like clipboard manager with pinboards, Quick Look previews, search, and one-click copying.

summary.one_liner: Clipbara is a free, open-source clipboard history manager for macOS with a Paste-style card panel, Pinboards, Quick Look previews, and an optional iPhone companion app.
summary.what_it_does: Clipbara records what you copy and shows it in a panel that opens with ⌘ ⇧ V at the bottom of the screen without taking focus from the current app. Clicking a clip puts it back on the clipboard, and search filters by content or title, with filters for type and date. Pinboards hold frequently reused clips, which can be moved between boards and reordered. Space opens Quick Look previews, ⌘ E edits text clips, and right-click offers rename, edit, and delete. The DMG build can paste directly into the active app through Accessibility permission, and Clip Queue pastes several copied items back in order. The App Store build adds optional iCloud sync with an iPhone app, which has a keyboard extension and a Paste button for saving clips.
use_cases: Recover something copied earlier in the day
Reuse frequently pasted snippets via Pinboards
Preview images or files before pasting
Keep clipboard history away from a password manager
Sync clipboard history between Mac and iPhone
Paste several copied items in sequence
how_to_run: Or download the latest .dmg from the Releases page and drag the app into Applications
Or install the Mac App Store build (free 7-day trial, then one-time purchase)
Build from source: git clone the repo, cd Clipbara, brew install xcodegen
open Clipbara.xcodeproj, then build and run the Clipbara scheme with ⌘ R
notable: Dual-licensed: GPLv3 source plus a separate proprietary App Store edition
Paste-into-active-app in the DMG build, with Accessibility permission
clipbara:// URL scheme for Raycast, Alfred, or Shortcuts
Companion iPhone app with iCloud sync and a custom keyboard extension
Excluded apps list so password managers are never recorded
caveats: Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later; iPhone app requires iOS 26 or later
iCloud sync and iPhone app are available only in the paid App Store build
Pasting into the active app is available only in the DMG build, not the App Store build
Images cannot be pasted into a plain shell prompt in terminal apps
